name: High Protein Oats Mum's Masala
ingredients_raw: Instant Oats (55.7%), Protein Blend (25.1%) (Texturised Soy Protein Flakes, Whey Powder), Seasoning {Sugar, Spices And Condiments, iodized Salt, Corn Flour, Black Salt, Hydrolyzed Vegetable Protein (Groundnut), Garlic, Dehydrated Fruit Powder (Lemon, Tomato), Onion, Mango, Flavours (Natural, Nature Identical), Milk Solids, Flavour Enhancers (Disodium 5'- Guanylate, Disodium 5'- Inosinate), Dehydrated Herbs (Coriander)), Himalayan Pink Salt, Seeds and Dehydrated Vegetables (1.5%) (Sunflower Seeds, Pumpkin Seeds, Dehydrated Carrot), Rice Bran Oil, Yeast Extract, Probiotics (Bacillus Coagulans SNZ 1969, 15 Billion CFU/g), Natural Flavour, Citric Acid.
